components.name: Primary Action

components.name: Deadlift Lower Third
components.description: A concise broadcast label for Gabriel's real 230 kilogram deadlift, not an alternate event picker.
components.css: .ds-lower-third { display: inline-flex; margin: 0; color: oklch(94% 0.015 85); background: oklch(14% 0.018 25); font: 700 12px/1.25 'Source Sans 3', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-lower-third span { padding: 8px 10px; color: oklch(14% 0.018 25); background: oklch(62% 0.20 29); } .ds-lower-third strong { padding: 8px 10px; }

components.name: Experience Plate
components.description: A lightweight competition-style plate. Each side of the 230 kilogram deadlift uses four red 25 kilogram plates and one white 5 kilogram plate, loaded against the outer sleeves.
components.css: .ds-plate { display: grid; width: 58px; aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; border: 5px solid oklch(58% 0.12 245); border-radius: 50%; color: oklch(94% 0.015 85); background: oklch(21% 0.024 25); font: 700 20px/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 3px 8px oklch(8% 0.01 25 / .7); }

narrative.overview: A recruiter watches one deliberate 230 kilogram deadlift on a competition broadcast, then reads a clean results sheet before the next candidate call. Strongman supplies the memorable frame, while four loading chapters introduce Gabriel's work, community, and service. One theatrical opening playscreen leads into conventional Experience, Projects, About, and Contact sections.
keyCharacteristics: One competition playscreen followed by a familiar recruiter journey.
Authentic lift photography with code-native broadcast graphics.
Barlow Condensed for physical force and Source Sans 3 for fast reading.
Ruled score tables and lower thirds instead of repeated cards.
An original GC plate badge with no implied sports affiliation.
Optional click-by-click lift motion that never gates Gabriel's story or navigation.

rules.name: The Broadcast Signal Rule
rules.body: Red prompts action, blue marks selection and plate hardware, and green confirms completion. Every colored state also needs text, shape, or icon support.

rules.name: The Human Voice Rule
rules.body: Display typography can be loud. Copy sounds like Gabriel speaking to a curious recruiter: warm, specific, and supported by the resume.

rules.name: The Optional Interaction Rule
rules.body: Identity, chapter labels, actions, and navigation remain available before, during, and without the lift sequence.

dos: Do place identity, May 2027 timing, role fit, four personal chapters, and direct actions in the first viewport.
Do use authentic strongman photography as the memorable personal frame.
Do keep Experience, Projects, About, and Contact familiar and fast to scan.
Do use score graphics, lower thirds, ruled tables, and plate geometry with restraint.
Do make every interactive result available as visible text.
Do use the original GC · LOAD TESTED · SYSTEMS · 2027 badge.
donts: Do not use the exact WSM logo, WORLD'S STRONGEST MAN branding, copied trade dress, or any implied affiliation.
Do not build a video game menu, fantasy environment, segmented quest, or recruiter traversal puzzle.
Do not use purple gradients, glass panels, repeated icon cards, or vague superlatives.
Do not use monospace as shorthand for engineering credibility.
Do not use gradient text, colored side-stripe borders, nested cards, decorative shadows, or chrome bevels.
Do not hide core content behind the lift interaction, menu, hover, or animation.
